name: Diagnose RAG Chunk Quality with AI: Compare Chunking Strategies Using Free Gemini Models

parameters.content:
## RAG Chunk-Quality Diagnostics Harness (100% free stack)

Everyone building RAG hits the same wall: answers are bad and nobody knows why.
Is it the chunking, the retrieval, or the model? This workflow answers that
question scientifically. It takes your PDFs, chunks them three different ways
(fixed-size, semantic, parent-document), runs your test questions against each
strategy, has an LLM judge score every answer for groundedness and recall, and
tells you which chunking strategy to ship for YOUR documents.

### Why this is different
Most RAG templates show the happy path: one chunker, one chatbot, fingers
crossed. This is a diagnostics harness. It runs a controlled bake-off, scores
every answer with a strict rubric, and outputs a decision: which strategy wins,
by how much, and which questions fail under each strategy. The vector
retrieval is hand-rolled with cosine similarity in plain Code nodes, so you can
see exactly what happens. No black boxes.

### Cost
Zero. Embeddings and judging run on the Gemini free tier (1,500 requests/day).
Google Drive, Sheets, and Gmail are free. The only credential you need is a
free Gemini API key from aistudio.google.com.

### Setup
1. Put your PDFs in a Google Drive folder. Paste the folder ID into the
Workflow Configuration node, along with your free Gemini API key.
2. Replace the four sample questions in the Test Question Set node with
questions your users actually ask, plus the keywords a good answer must contain.
3. Connect Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Gmail. Run with the manual trigger.
4. Read the emailed report: it names the winning strategy and lists every
question's scores under each strategy.

### Honest notes
- This is a diagnostics harness, not a production chatbot. Once you know the
winner, rebuild your production RAG with that chunking strategy and a
persistent vector store (Qdrant, Supabase, Pinecone).
- The LLM judge is non-deterministic. Scores use temperature 0 and a fixed
rubric, and per-question scores are shown so flakiness is visible.
- Semantic chunking embeds every sentence once. For very large document sets,
watch the free-tier quota; the maxCharsPerDoc setting caps input size.

### 1 | Trigger + configuration
Manual run, or drop PDFs into the watched Drive folder. Configuration holds the free Gemini API key, folder ID, chunking sizes, and topK. Edit the Test Question Set with questions your users actually ask.

### 2 | Ingest
List PDFs in the Drive folder, download them, extract text. The extracted text fans out to all three chunking arms.

### 3 | Arm A: fixed-size chunking
Recursive paragraph/sentence splitting with overlap. The baseline every RAG starts with.

### 4 | Arm B: semantic chunking
Sentences embedded with Gemini, chunks cut where meaning shifts. Costs one embedding pass over your sentences (free tier).

### 5 | Arm C: parent-document chunking
Small child chunks for precise retrieval, each carrying a slice of its parent section as context. The technique most n8n users have never seen.

### 6 | Decision
Merge the three arms, average groundedness and recall per strategy, crown the winner, log every question's scores to Sheets, and email the report.
